values.note: Water spigots to fill containers through the loop (shut off Oct 31). No flush toilets or showers in the loop; campers may use the camper services building (flush toilets, showers) in Early Settlers. The park's dump station closes Oct 31.

values.note: June nights: basic sites $28, the same on a Saturday (CPW's park page gives $20-36 across the park's site types and seasons). Plus tax, CPW's reservation fee (per stay) and a vehicle pass ($4 a day to $80 a year at this park).

values.note: A reservation is required (cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613), up to six months ahead; a vehicle pass must be displayed. 14 days within a 28-day period. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon.

note: Basic loop at Vega State Park (~8,000 ft) on the meadow above the reservoir's east arm, on its own loop road; one of the park's four campgrounds (Early Settlers, Oak Point, Island are separate entries). The north sites (201-205) look over a marshy meadow to the reservoir; the shoreline is marsh, not beach. Grand Mesa trails and fishing nearby. --Claude
summary: CPW camping page + cpwshop per-site pages: confirmed 28 sites (all Basic, 17 pull-throughs, 25-50 ft, all but one 30 ft+), no hookups (Early Settlers only), water spigots, reservation only (6 months, 14 in 28 days), no winter camping, $28 (June 2027, weekend the same); added max_rig_ft 50, booking url/window, fees checked 2027 with vehicle pass + per-stay reservation fee. Note cleaned: dropped 'Camp Colorado', the RV Life line and field facts.
flags: Hookups: cpwshop's page for site 200HA lists 'Electricity Hookup: 50' and 'Water Hookup: Y', but it is typed and priced Basic ($28, same as every other Aspen Grove site) and CPW's camping page says 'Early Settlers is the only campground with hookups.' Treated as a catalog error (or a host/ADA utility); recorded no hookups from the CPW page.
Toilets: stored vault_toilets true (from note prose) is not stated for Aspen Grove; CPW says only 'These campgrounds have no flushing toilets or showers'. Left as stored.

Loop distances (site centroid 39.22205,-107.77962 to the stored pins): Oak Point (2287) 1.3 km, Island (15569) 1.6 km, Early Settlers (2285) 2.8 km. On NAIP Aspen Grove is its own loop on a spur off the park road on the reservoir's east side; it does not share a loop with any of the other three.
Pin 39.2221,-107.7796 is 6 m from the cpwshop GIS centroid and 13 m from the nearest site. OK.
Season: CPW gives no opening/closing dates for campsites, only 'No campsites are available in the winter' and spigots off Oct 31. No date recorded.

Waterfront 'lakeview' kept: cpwshop shows no Proximity to Water tag on any Aspen Grove site. On NAIP (low water) the nearest sites (204, 202, 205) are ~180-200 m from the waterline across marsh meadow and exposed mudflat; even at full pool the loop is set back behind a marsh fringe (the stored evidence measured ~70 m to the arm). No site reaches the water. The 2026 boat ramps are closed 'due to low water conditions', so the water is farther off than usual this fall.
